facts.text: ECI announced the annual **Special Summary Revision (SSR)** of rolls for **6** States/UTs (Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim, Chandigarh, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu) where SIR is complete; draft rolls **30 Nov**, final **21 Jan 2027**; Aadhaar in Forms 6/8 stays **voluntary**.

facts.text: The SSR was earlier announced (15 Oct) for **17** States/UTs including poll-bound **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Manipur and Goa**.

facts.text: Activists **Anjali Bhardwaj and Amrita Johri** sought FIRs over alleged **Form 7 forgery** in Delhi's Mustafabad, and a full audit of Form 7 filings; **₹47.56 lakh** names were dropped from Delhi's draft roll (published 31 Aug); final roll deadline pushed to **22 December**.
facts.plain: Activists Anjali Bhardwaj and Amrita Johri sought FIRs over alleged Form 7 forgery in Delhi's Mustafabad, and a full audit of Form 7 filings; ₹47.56 lakh names were dropped from Delhi's draft roll (published 31 Aug); final roll deadline pushed to 22 December.

facts.text: ECI restored oversight of its **IT wing** (headed by **Seema Khanna**) under a Deputy Election Commissioner, reversing a July order that had let her report directly to the Commission, after ECs **S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi** objected.

facts.text: Elaborating its 'arrest begins at detention' ruling, the SC held any person **detained beyond 24 hours** must be released immediately on production before a Magistrate, who must record the **actual time of detention**; only travel time to court is excluded from the 24-hour count.

facts.text: A 3-storey **unauthorised** building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's **Chawri Bazar**, killing 2 and trapping others; Delhi Police had flagged the illegal construction as early as **15 June**; it is Delhi's **3rd major building collapse since 6 September**, after 13 deaths.
facts.plain: A 3-storey unauthorised building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's Chawri Bazar, killing 2 and trapping others; Delhi Police had flagged the illegal construction as early as 15 June; it is Delhi's 3rd major building collapse since 6 September, after 13 deaths.

facts.text: On the Danger-in-the-sewer editorial: **859** sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025), **332** across 18 States/UTs (2021-26); SC's *Dr. Balram Singh* (2023) raised death compensation to **₹30 lakh** per worker.

facts.text: DRDO successfully flight-tested the indigenous quasi-ballistic missile **Pralay** from **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island**, Odisha, on 5 Nov, in a user-evaluation trial clearing the way for its induction into the armed forces.

facts.text: The government clarified **Agnipath is not rolled back**: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before, while the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement, after which all willing and fit Agniveers can join the regular cadre with **protected seniority**.
facts.plain: The government clarified Agnipath is not rolled back: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before, while the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement, after which all willing and fit Agniveers can join the regular cadre with protected seniority.

facts.text: NPCI told the SC that **'zero MDR' on all UPI transactions is unsustainable**; the new **0.4% MDR** applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions **above ₹2,000** (about **4%** of merchant transactions); P2P and small P2M stay free. UPI processed **24.51 billion** transactions worth **₹29.82 lakh crore** in August 2026 alone.

facts.text: SC (Justice **Ujjal Bhuyan**): an **arrest begins the moment** an official **touches** a person to restrain their liberty, starting the **24-hour** clock under **Article 22(2)** then and there, not from the time of formal arrest.

facts.text: A **tokamak** confines fusion plasma magnetically in a ring; the concept came from Soviet physicists **Igor Tamm and Andrei Sakharov** (1950s). **ITER** (7 members: China, EU, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia, US) is being built at **Cadarache, France**. India's tokamaks — **ADITYA/ADITYA-U** (1989/2017) and **SST-1** (2013) — are at the **Institute for Plasma Research, Gandhinagar**.

ITER (7 members: China, EU, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia, US) is being built at Cadarache, France. India's tokamaks — ADITYA/ADITYA-U (1989/2017) and SST-1 (2013) — are at the Institute for Plasma Research, Gandhinagar.

facts.text: China's **EAST** tokamak (Hefei) sustained high-confinement plasma for **1,066 seconds** in Jan 2025, a world record; no tokamak has yet produced **net commercial energy**.
